title: Canonical maps and injective normalization for support comparison
statement: For a scheme T, a coefficient ring A (commutative for the support and open-coefficient clauses), and a closed immersion i:C → T with open complement j, use the ordinary etale/pro-etale module comparison adjunction [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Define the comparison on sections over any etale object V by evaluating the ordinary adjunction unit. Its right-derived-plus base-change morphism is finiteComparisonSection. Whiskering this morphism, the canonical supported comparison [lem-pur-support-site-comparison], and the unit-normalized global comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-global-cohomology] by integer homology gives the three prescribed graded comparison maps. The canonical open coefficient isomorphism is the composite of the two localization-restriction identifications and the comparison-pullback isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback]. SupportBoundaryOpenUnitNormalized asserts the resulting ordinary-unit equality on this open. For a site, a restriction arrow and a natural support boundary [thm-pur-with-support-exactness], supportBoundaryNormalization asserts that on every bounded-below injective complex it is the snake connecting map of the kernel/restriction short exact row, conjugated by the canonical right-derived-unit homology isomorphisms. These are the eight unchanged definitions formerly placed in SupportComparisonBoundary.

def finiteComparisonSectionUnit (T : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type (u + 1)) [Ring A]
    (V : Scheme.Etale T) :
    (sheafToPresheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ⋙
      (evaluation _ _).obj (op V)) ⋙ 𝟭 (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ⟶
      comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T ⋙
        (sheafToPresheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ⋙
          (evaluation _ _).obj (op ((Scheme.toProEt T).obj V)))
